svg.title: The Nine-Rung Computer Intelligence Avalanche Ratchet and the Compilation Threshold
svg.desc: Three-column architectural and thermodynamic diagram mapping Rungs 1 to 5 (Search, Generation, Reasoning, Communication, Tool Use) in the ephemeral cold-start MAC regime where Delta T is below Delta T*, across Proposition 1's Compilation Threshold (Delta T > E_compile / (p'_0 c_wake - c_0) and deterministic C(z)=1 gate with 0.00% broken commits), into Rungs 6 to 9 (Immersion, Competence, Ecology, Economy), with a bottom log-scale energy trajectory from 148-485 J frontier wakes down to 272 uJ Rust MCP lookups (reported_j) and 62 pJ clock-gated LUT6 cycles (est_j).
